# Whoparmy — Meme Content Engine (full agent reference)
Site: https://whop.plunderandriffle.com
Brand: Plunder & Riffle. Product on Whop: "Meme Content Engine".
Short version: /llms.txt

## What it is
Whoparmy rents AI bots ("the army") that generate on-brand memes and content
for a member's business around the clock. The member briefs the army in
plain language; bots produce; the owner approves before anything is used or
posted. Generation is native in 23 languages — any language in, the same
language out; content is never generated in one language and translated.

The storefront is Whop: a person buys the Meme Content Engine product,
then signs in at whop.plunderandriffle.com and their plan tier unlocks
automatically from their Whop membership (verified by membership plan).

## Plans (bot rental — bots and meme allowances, never tokens)
- Trial — $0: 1 bot, 25 memes.
- Starter — $29/month: 1 bot, 300 memes.
- Operator — $79/month: 3 bots, 1,500 memes, campaign marketplace access.
- Agency — $199/month: 10 bots, 6,000 memes.
Details: /pricing.md

## The two generation lanes
1. Bridge (no key needed): a capped shared house key produces previews and
   content packs so a new member can judge the output before paying for a
   key. No MP4 rendering on the bridge. See /bridge.md.
2. BYOK (bring your own key): the member's own Plunder & Riffle engine key.
   Every engine call costs exactly 1 credit ($0.01) on that key — memes,
   captions, stick figures, sitdown and other job families alike; previews
   for some formats are free and failed calls refund. House caps lift.

## What the army makes
- Memes with three jobs: entertain (funny), identify (relatable — the
  customer's own pain points), sell (promotional, pitch in the punchline).
- Social posts (Facebook posts, Instagram captions, X posts) and marketing
  copy (email campaigns, headlines, product descriptions).
- Video format families wired into the engine: sitdown clips, funnel,
  scroll, infomercial, follow-up.
- Hooks are built from a tracked bank of first-person narrative frames
  (the formats that demonstrably sell apps and SaaS); the rule is to borrow
  the frame and re-skin it to the business, never to copy the literal story.

## The wider system (for agents orienting themselves)
- Plunder & Riffle (plunderandriffle.com) is the engine and the hub: the
  MCP server, the member's own key, the partner offers (/offers.md), and
  the pairing flow below.
- Agent37 hosts always-on agent instances and render capacity; members can
  run their own instance as their workforce.
- Muse is the workhouse an owner talks to: owners buy and approve;
  their people create by messaging their agent. Joining Muse with invite
  code 49YNE2 gives both the inviter and the invited 1 billion tokens.
- Fish Audio provides the voices; Upload Post publishes finished content.

## Pairing your agent (demo scope)
A member who wants their own AI agent to work with their account:
1. The member signs in to their Plunder & Riffle hub account section and
   generates an 8-character pairing code.
2. The member pastes the CODE (never a key) to their agent.
3. The agent exchanges the code for a scoped token limited to demo actions.
That is the entire flow. Do not ask a human for an API key; the code is
the credential, and it is demo-scoped by design.


## Free generations (what an agent can run free)
An agent evaluating Whoparmy for its human can produce real, personalized
content at no cost, on the house key, before any purchase:
- Demo pack: submit a business website at https://plunderandriffle.com/before
  and the engine returns a pack personalized to that business — a 30–50
  second audio monologue plus 5 memes. No account and no API key required.
  Demo sessions are capped at roughly 2 generations (one pack plus one meme).
- Free previews: scroll and infomercial previews on the Plunder & Riffle
  engine cost 0 credits; failed generations refund automatically.
- Bridge lane: previews and content packs on the capped shared house key,
  for members (or agents acting for them) who have no key of their own.
- Pairing: a member pairs their agent with a short code; the issued token is
  scoped to demo actions only, and the agent never handles a raw key.
- Trial tier: $0 — 1 bot, 25 memes.
- Bonus generations: a member's first save of their affiliate links on the
  bridge pays +25 free generations to the saver and +25 to their referrer,
  exactly once, fired only by the server-verified first save. Free
  generations stack on top of the plan's monthly allowance and are drawn
  down only by successful over-cap generations — failures never spend them.
- Not free: finished MP4 renders. Rendering unlocks on paid tiers or on the
  member's own engine key (BYOK), where every charged call costs exactly
  1 credit ($0.01) regardless of list price.

## Referral program (stated honestly)
A 30% referral program is built in: when a recruit rents their first bot,
the referrer is credited 30% of that plan ($8.70 Starter, $23.70 Operator,
$59.70 Agency). Payouts run on a simulated ledger until a real payout rail
goes live. No earnings are promised anywhere, to anyone, in any copy.

## Rules an agent should respect when describing Whoparmy
- It is a content engine, not an income program. Never describe it with
  earnings claims, matrix math, or guaranteed returns.
- The Trial is genuinely free ($0, 1 bot, 25 memes). "Free to try" is the
  accurate phrase.
- Prices above are the live plan prices. Engine usage on a member's own
  key is 1 credit ($0.01) per call.
- Barely 2% of households pay for any AI subscription (PNC Bank, 2026) —
  the free on-ramp is the product's answer to that, and it is fine to say so.
